Combatant is a temporary PvP title earned for reaching a PvP rating of 1000+. The title itself is rewarded by achievements for the associated season. However, this title is considered a "seasonal title" and will be removed at the end of the current season it was obtained in and must be earned once again in the upcoming season to reequip it. It precedes the name in the following format: :Combatant Winning Rated PvP matches while at this rank or higher will eventually reward the season's Vicious mount, with further completes rewarding a Vicious Saddle to buy previous season Vicious mounts.

Comp Stomp was a PvP Brawl in which a team of 15 Alliance or Horde players travel to Arathi Basin to compete in the Battleground against a team of 15 NPCs of the opposing faction in place of a team of players. The rules are exactly the same as in the regular battleground, except a few points regarding the enemy NPCs. As an example, the NPCs will be able to dodge attacks from behind, unlike players. The NPCs can also be tricked with simple Line of sight maneuvers. It was replaced in favor of a permanent game mode called Training Grounds.

The Communal Reservoir Key is an account-wide attunement key used to access Heroic mode for Coilfang Reservoir instances (Slave Pens, the Underbog, and the Steamvault). It is contained in the Communal Reservoir Pouch.

The Communal Auchenai Key is an account-wide attunement key used to access Heroic mode for the Auchindoun instances (Mana-Tombs, Auchenai Crypts, Sethekk Halls, and the Shadow Labyrinth). It is contained in the Communal Auchenai Pouch.

The Communal Warpforged Key is an account-wide attunement key used to access Heroic mode for Tempest Keep instances (the Mechanar, the Botanica, and the Arcatraz). It is contained in the Communal Warpforged Pouch.

The Communal Kitchen is a building on the northwestern edge of Mereldar. It is occupied and operated by the Arathi Kiera Horth and guarded by her Imperial lynx Beria. Horth can be found in the kitchen at all hours, preparing food for the people of Mereldar. The tome 500 Dishes Using Cave Fish and Mushrooms can be found on one of her tables, alongside various other cooking utensils and ingredients.

Concord Observatory is a ruined observatory found in the Waking Shores. Azerothian Archives records indicate that the dragonkin in the observatory were mapping heavenly bodies in an attempt to predict the future. Ruby Tenders and Ruby Wardens can be found in the area, seemingly in the process of fixing up the observatory. The topmost levels of the observatory are a roosting place for dreadsqualls. Nulltheria the Void Gazer can occasionally be found at the top of the highest tower. Zenata leads a technoscrying into the area in order to discover new archeological finds on the place.

Conquest Hold Windragers are orcs riding wyverns who spawn above Conquest Hold in the Grizzly Hills and pursue the Wintergarde Gryphon for a little while during The Hills Have Us.

Conquest of the Ancients is a buff that makes a player's alts on the same server gain 50% more Conquest Points once they have earned the maximum of 9,000 on one character in that weekly reset period. It lasts until the weekly reset, persisting through death and having no duration.
Conspicuiously Busy Laborers are dredgers found at Dominance Keep in Revendreth during Out On the Edge.
Console Encryption Key drops from Hal'hadar enemies on Naigtal.
The Conquest Quartermaster refers to the NPC of an expansion who sells PvP-related items and gear for Conquest.

The Console Orb is an interactive console located in the Umbral Base Camp on both Naigtal and Val. More entries are added as quests are completed. Archmage Y'mera can be seen communing with it as she stands in front of it.

A construct is an animated object or artificially (perhaps technologically) constructed creature. Mechanicals are a type of construct. Note: While construct is used to describe a few specific races with similar characteristics, it does not mean that all are related.
